chunks.head: come upon
chunks.gloss: (想法/感觉)突然袭来;偶然遇到
chunks.note: 此处 a desire came upon him = 一个念头突然涌上心头;也可表'偶然碰到'。

literal.note_cn: (此处)落到某人身上,非'在上面'

chunks.ex_en: A strange feeling came upon her when she opened the old box.
chunks.ex_cn: 她打开那只旧箱子时,一种奇怪的感觉突然涌上心头。

chunks.head: stumble upon
chunks.note: stumble upon sb/sth = 无意中撞见、偶然发现。
chunks.ex_en: I stumbled upon an old photo while cleaning my room.
chunks.ex_cn: 打扫房间时我偶然翻到一张旧照片。

chunks.head: take a hand in
chunks.note: take a hand in sth = 动手参与某事、出一份力。
chunks.ex_en: He is always glad to take a hand in any new project.
chunks.ex_cn: 他总是乐意参与任何新项目。

chunks.head: by and by
chunks.note: 旧式固定表达,= 过些时候、终究。

literal.note_cn: 叠用成固定短语,不单独取义

chunks.ex_en: Wait here, and by and by the bus will come.
chunks.ex_cn: 在这儿等着,过一会儿公交车就来了。

chunks.head: stick out
chunks.note: stick out = 凸出、伸出来。
chunks.ex_en: The boy let his tongue stick out to make me laugh.
chunks.ex_cn: 那男孩把舌头伸出来逗我笑。

chunks.head: set out
chunks.note: set out (on/for) = 启程、开始一段旅程。
chunks.ex_en: We set out early in the morning to climb the hill.
chunks.ex_cn: 我们一大早就出发去爬山。

chunks.head: get one's claws on
chunks.note: get one's claws on sth = 像猛兽一样把某物抓到手,含贪婪义。
chunks.ex_en: If he gets his claws on my candy, he'll eat it all.
chunks.ex_cn: 要是让他抓到我的糖,他会全吃光。

chunks.head: clean out
chunks.note: 本章出处为分离式(clean it out),故 card-only。clean sth out = 把里面的东西全弄光。
chunks.ex_en: The thieves cleaned out the whole shop in one night.
chunks.ex_cn: 小偷一夜之间把整间店洗劫一空。

chunks.head: peg away
chunks.gloss: 埋头苦干、坚持不懈地干
chunks.note: peg away (at) = 不停歇地努力做。
chunks.ex_en: She pegged away at her homework until it was done.
chunks.ex_cn: 她埋头做作业,直到全部做完。

chunks.head: make a difference
chunks.note: 本章为否定式 make no/any difference = 没关系、无所谓。
chunks.ex_en: It doesn't make any difference which seat you take.
chunks.ex_cn: 你坐哪个座位都没关系。

chunks.head: find out
chunks.note: find out = 打听到、发现（事实）。
chunks.ex_en: Let's find out when the store opens.
chunks.ex_cn: 咱们查一下这家店几点开门。

chunks.head: fool away
chunks.note: fool away = 虚耗、白费。
chunks.ex_en: Don't fool away the whole afternoon playing games.
chunks.ex_cn: 别把整个下午都白白耗在打游戏上。

chunks.head: go for
chunks.gloss: 去取、去追（拿/攻）；努力争取
chunks.note: go for sth = 去把它弄到手、去争取（此处指'去挖/去取那宝藏'）。
chunks.ex_en: If you want the prize, just go for it!
chunks.ex_cn: 想要那个奖,就去争取吧!

chunks.head: keep pace with
chunks.note: keep pace with = 保持同样速度、不落后。
chunks.ex_en: He walked fast, and I could hardly keep pace with him.
chunks.ex_cn: 他走得很快,我几乎跟不上他。

chunks.head: give up
chunks.note: 本章出处为分离式(give this one up),故 card-only。give sth up = 不再继续。
chunks.ex_en: Don't give up—you are almost there.
chunks.ex_cn: 别放弃,你就快成功了。

chunks.head: look out for
chunks.note: look out for sb/sth = 看守、小心提防（此处指'守着宝藏'）。
chunks.ex_en: Please look out for my bag while I buy tickets.
chunks.ex_cn: 我去买票,请帮我看着包。

chunks.head: fool around
chunks.note: fool around = 闲荡、不正经地待着。
chunks.ex_en: Stop fooling around and finish your work.
chunks.ex_cn: 别瞎混了,把活干完。

chunks.head: get into trouble
chunks.note: get into trouble (with) = 招惹麻烦。
chunks.ex_en: You'll get into trouble if you break the rules.
chunks.ex_cn: 你要是破坏规矩就会惹上麻烦。

chunks.head: grit one's teeth
chunks.note: grit one's teeth = 咬牙硬撑,或愤怒/害怕时咬牙。
chunks.ex_en: She gritted her teeth and finished the long race.
chunks.ex_cn: 她咬紧牙关跑完了这场长跑。

chunks.head: stand to reason
chunks.note: it stands to reason (that) = 道理很明显、显而易见。
chunks.ex_en: It stands to reason that plants need water to grow.
chunks.ex_cn: 植物需要水才能生长,这是理所当然的。

chunks.head: cave in
chunks.note: cave in = （屋顶/矿坑等）向内塌下。
chunks.ex_en: The old roof caved in after the heavy snow.
chunks.ex_cn: 大雪之后那旧屋顶塌了下来。

chunks.head: give a wide berth
chunks.note: 本章出处为分离式(give the haunted house a wide berth),故 card-only。give sth a wide berth = 离得远远的。
chunks.ex_en: I always give that angry dog a wide berth.
chunks.ex_cn: 我总是远远躲开那条凶狗。

chunks.head: have a good time
chunks.note: have a good time = 尽兴、玩得高兴。
chunks.ex_en: We had a good time at the party last night.
chunks.ex_cn: 昨晚的聚会我们玩得很开心。

chunks.head: come after
chunks.note: come after sth/sb = 回来取、来追。
chunks.ex_en: If you leave your coat, I'll come after you with it.
chunks.ex_cn: 你要是落下外套,我会拿着追上你。
